name: AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D Desktop Processor Boxed
shortDescription: AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D Retail Boxed Gaming Desktop Processor (Official Sealed Box Edition / Zen 4 Architecture / 8 Cores & 16 Threads / Up to 5.0 GHz Max Boost / Massive 96MB L3 3D V-Cache / AM5 Socket / PCIe 5.0 Suppor
descriptionHtml:
AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D Retail Boxed Gaming Desktop Processor (Official Sealed Box Edition / Zen 4 Architecture / 8 Cores & 16 Threads / Up to 5.0 GHz Max Boost / Massive 96MB L3 3D V-Cache / AM5 Socket / PCIe 5.0 Support / 120W TDP / 1-Year Warranty)

Experience ultimate gaming performance with the official Retail Boxed AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D Desktop Processor, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Warranty (ضمان سنة). Supplied in its factory-sealed retail box packaging, this 8-core, 16-thread powerhouse is built on Zen 4 architecture with revolutionary AMD 3D V-Cache technology. Designed for the advanced AM5 socket platform with PCIe 5.0 support, Precision Boost 2, and AMD EXPO memory profiles, it delivers unmatched speed and efficiency for high-end gaming rigs.
